failures.question: Show a list of active customers
failures.generated_sql: SELECT c.id, c.nome FROM clientes c WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM vendas v WHERE v.cliente_id = c.id AND v.status = 'Pago')

failures.question: Show total sales per employee in 2023
failures.generated_sql: SELECT funcionario_id, SUM(valor_total) AS total_sales FROM vendas WHERE strftime('%Y', data_venda) = '2023' GROUP BY funcionario_id
failures.gold_sql: SELECT f.id, f.nome, COUNT(v.id) AS order_count, SUM(v.valor_total) AS revenue FROM funcionarios f LEFT JOIN vendas v ON v.funcionario_id = f.id AND strftime('%Y', v.data_venda) = '2023' GROUP BY f.id, f.nome ORDER BY order_count DESC

failures.question: Find the top 3 clients with the highest total order value
failures.generated_sql: SELECT cliente_id, SUM(valor_total) AS total_valor FROM vendas GROUP BY cliente_id ORDER BY total_valor DESC LIMIT 3
failures.gold_sql: SELECT c.id, c.nome, SUM(v.valor_total) AS revenue FROM clientes c JOIN vendas v ON v.cliente_id = c.id GROUP BY c.id, c.nome ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 3

failures.question: Which product categories had more than one distinct product sold?
failures.generated_sql:
SELECT p.categoria
FROM produtos p
JOIN itens_venda iv ON iv.produto_id = p.id
GROUP BY p.categoria
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) > 1
failures.gold_sql: SELECT p.categoria, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS products_sold FROM itens_venda iv JOIN produtos p ON iv.produto_id = p.id GROUP BY p.categoria HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) > 1

failures.question: Total geral de vendas agrupado por status do pedido
failures.generated_sql: SELECT status, SUM(valor_total) AS total_vendas FROM vendas GROUP BY status
failures.gold_sql: SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS count, SUM(valor_total) AS total FROM vendas GROUP BY status ORDER BY status

failures.question: Which employees have a supervisor?
failures.generated_sql: SELECT id, nome, email, cargo, departamento, salario, data_admissao, telefone, endereco, ativo, supervisor_id FROM funcionarios WHERE supervisor_id IS NOT NULL
failures.gold_sql: SELECT id, nome, cargo, departamento FROM funcionarios WHERE supervisor_id IS NOT NULL

failures.question: Departments with budget less than 200000
failures.gold_sql: SELECT nome, orcamento FROM departamentos WHERE orcamento < 200000

failures.question: What is the most expensive product?
failures.generated_sql: SELECT id, nome, preco_venda FROM produtos ORDER BY preco_venda DESC LIMIT 1
failures.gold_sql: SELECT * FROM produtos ORDER BY preco_venda DESC LIMIT 1

failures.question: What was the total discount given across all sales?
failures.generated_sql: SELECT SUM(valor_bruto * desconto / 100.0) AS total_discount FROM vendas
failures.gold_sql: SELECT SUM(valor_bruto - valor_total) AS total_discount FROM vendas

failures.question: How many suppliers does XPTO have?
failures.generated_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT fornecedor_principal) AS supplier_count FROM produtos
failures.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_suppliers FROM fornecedores

failures.question: Pedidos com valor total acima de 5000 e que já foram pagos
failures.generated_sql: SELECT id, numero_pedido, valor_total, status FROM vendas WHERE valor_total > 5000 AND status = 'Pago'
failures.gold_sql: SELECT * FROM vendas WHERE valor_total > 5000 AND status = 'Pago'

failures.question: What is the net revenue after discount for each sale?
failures.generated_sql:
SELECT v.id, v.numero_pedido, SUM(iv.valor_total_item) AS net_revenue
FROM vendas v
JOIN itens_venda iv ON iv.venda_id = v.id
GROUP BY v.id, v.numero_pedido
failures.gold_sql: SELECT id, numero_pedido, valor_bruto, desconto, valor_total, (valor_bruto - valor_total) AS discount_amount FROM vendas
